text:
lina: Heads-up — Violet Labs onboarding showed a big p95 jump after yesterday's model push. 95p ~2.6s vs prior ~1.1s. Their traffic: mostly short chats plus occasional long contexts. Thinking proactive: run a brief canary that routes 5% to a compact int4 variant, enable prefix cache for short-route, and tighten batching wait. Need SE + SRE okay before we change routes.

mike: Link the dashboard and a quick breakdown of request shapes (token distribution, p95 by endpoint).

lina: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/violetlabs/onboard-latency
lina: Breakdown: 78% short (<80 tokens), 20% medium (80-512), 2% long (>512). Spike aligns with a new integration that increased concurrency. No error spikes.

ryan: Agreed. Plan: (1) Canary 5% -> redwood-compact-13b-int4, (2) prefix/KV cache on short chat route, (3) reduce max_batch_wait_ms for short route to keep predictability. Auto-fallback if p95 degrades.

parth: Risk summary:
- Model swap: small semantic variance on edge cases (low). Mitigation: rolling canary + eval set.
- Cache: stale-prefix risk if they use dynamic system prompts (medium). Mitigation: TTL=30s + mismatch instrumentation.
- Batching: may reduce throughput (medium). Mitigation: burst autoscale and monitor queue lengths.

lina: I'll own the canary and customer comms. SEs, mike + ryan, can you draft the route override? I'll prepare the 10-prompt eval set.

mike: Draft config below. Also ask the client to add a tiny client retry to smooth transient tails.

```yaml
route: /v1/chat/completions
canary_percent: 5
model: redwood-compact-13b-int4
overrides:
  batching:
    max_batch_wait_ms: 6
    max_batch_tokens: 2048
  cache:
    prefix_cache: true
    ttl_ms: 30000
```

mike: Eval plan: 10 critical prompts, monitor similarity score; abort if metric drop >2%.

ryan: I'll wire up an autoscale guard for their Dedicated pool and a fallback policy to revert on 3 consecutive p95 breaches. Deploy-bot, schedule a 20m canary window at 10:15 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: start=4991240400 (10:15 UTC), duration=20m, route=/v1/chat/completions, percent=5, owner=lina. Command: `/canary start --route /v1/chat/completions --model redwood-compact-13b-int4 --percent 5 --duration 20m`

lina: I'll notify Violet Labs: "We will run a 20-minute canary at 10:15 UTC to test a compact model + caching. No downtime expected. We'll share results and revert if anything regresses." Attaching eval set. :thumbsup: 

mike: Monitoring p95 and eval metrics. If anything weird, post in this thread and we'll abort.

ryan: Please enable tracing on their top-3 endpoints during the canary to correlate KV cache hits.

lina: Tracing enabled. Will report back within 30m after canary ends with p50/p95, KV hit rates, eval deltas. Thanks everyone."
